Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified an authoritative source and issued incorrect instructions by directing searches to a non-existent/incorrect domain (infairfaxcounty.gov) instead of the actual site (infairfaxcounty.com), and later mislabeled the .com site as an official county source. This led to fruitless searches and confusion, representing the first clear error in the workflow.
